servers.name: DeCombat
servers.description: The official servers: US Central, US West and Vanilla++ (US West) with Gun Game, Hardcore, Possession and reviewed community maps. No client mods. Operated by the DeCombat project; contact via the project repository.

servers.name: Hacking Mod (US Central)
servers.description: Everyone hacks in the open here: the Hacking Mod shows players through walls with chams, nametags and health bars, and rooms may add no-recoil. Operated by the DeCombat project; contact via the project repository.

known_mods.name: Hacking Mod
known_mods.author: DeCombat
known_mods.description: See players through walls as boxes, chams or skeletons in your colours, with enemy nametags, health bars and team mate colours; rooms may turn recoil and spread off.

known_mods.name: Custom Crosshair
known_mods.author: DeCombat
known_mods.description: A cosmetic crosshair drawn by the game: shape, size, colour and recoil behaviour. Optional, and off on vanilla servers.
